title: Record that the stock receipt leaves every selected coefficient null
body:
## Summary
- The bootstrap audit receipt has fourteen stages. Every `actual_stock_coefficient` is null, and the source boundary repeats that null. Completed inner-leaf borrowing is 0.
- The historical candidate is width 120 with coefficient 57,604. The selected candidate is width 73 and carries no coefficient. The receipt marks `sigma_j = sigma_0 + j*57604` as not established.
- Partial result. No cutoff margin is recomputed. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
